scan_linter_check.description:
Flags server calls in browser-side scripts that block the browser until the server responds: - GlideAjax getXMLWait() - g_form.getReference(field) without a callback - query() without a callback on a GlideRecord created in the script
Applies to Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, Catalog UI Policies and UI Scripts. For UI Actions with Client set, only getXMLWait() and g_form.getReference() are checked, because the same script may also contain server code where GlideRecord.query() is normal. Service Portal widgets are not checked.
getXML() and getXMLAnswer() without a callback are asynchronous and are not flagged by this rule.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-CLIENT-001: Synchronous server call in a client-side script
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Use an asynchronous call with a callback: GlideAjax getXMLAnswer(callback) or getXML(callback), g_form.getReference(field, callback), or GlideRecord query(callback). Synchronous calls freeze the form, and getXMLWait() is not available in Service Portal.
scan_linter_check.short_description: getXMLWait(), or getReference() or GlideRecord query() without a callback.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-CLIENT-001: Synchronous server call in a client-side script
